(3) He sits back down and presents a white box for a 'USB-C to 3.5mm Audio Jack Adapter' directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands as he speaks with an expressive facial expression. (4) Graphic icons of a Nintendo Switch and a PS5 controller appear at the bottom as he holds the adapter and headphones together. (5) Close-up shot focusing on his hands as he struggles to tear open the white cardboard packaging of the new Apple cable. (9) He puts the purple headphones on his ears, and a digital overlay of Jay Chou's album cover 'November's Chopin' appears next to the iPod. (10) He closes his eyes and nods his head rhythmically to music, while animated white musical note graphics float around his head. (11) He looks back at the camera, holding the iPod and headphones, smiling and concluding his presentation.
